_comment: The decorating room's voice-over script. BOTH the durable production record (CONCEPT.md §7.3) AND the runtime manifest — bundled into the app and read by VoiceBank.swift, which maps line id -> variant files. VoiceBank loads every bundled script-*.json, so this file needed no Swift change beyond the id constants in VersierLine.

_why.the_idle_line_is_not_an_instruction: GAMEPLAY.md §6.4 is explicit about this and it is the one place this room's dialogue differs in kind from every other room's. There is no required action here, so there is nothing she can be failing to do — an idle nudge that said 'put something on the cake' would invent the required action the whole room exists without. `zullenWeGaan` is 'it is already lovely, shall we go?' and it alternates with `stil`, which is just 'I am still here'.
_why.the_door_still_says_soon: The party does not exist. `deurRonde` promises a feest that is coming *straks* rather than one she is about to be taken to, because ROOMS.md §9 forbids promising a room that is not built and a 4-year-old told she is going somewhere and then not taken there has been lied to.
_why.mooi_is_low_priority_on_purpose: She will place dozens of stickers. A line for each would be a lift announcement, so `mooi` fires about one time in five and at .low priority, which VoiceBank drops outright if anyone is already speaking. The four named reactions in §6.4 — a sticker placed, the first candle lit, the tenth sprinkle, the cake turned all the way round — fire once each and at normal priority.
_why.length: Gracie reads Dutch at 15–17 characters a second, so these were written to a measured length rather than trimmed afterwards. Nothing here is longer than about four seconds.

_line_ids._comment: What the game calls, and when. Every id here is referenced from Swift (VersierLine); every id in VersierLine exists here.
_line_ids.nina.versieren.hallo: On entering the room, either from the kitchen or on a visit.
_line_ids.nina.versieren.eerste: The first sticker of the session lands on the cake. Once.
_line_ids.nina.versieren.mooi: Occasional low-priority encouragement as she keeps decorating.
_line_ids.nina.versieren.kaarsAan: The first candle is lit. Once.
_line_ids.nina.versieren.rondje: The turntable has been turned a full circle. Once.
_line_ids.nina.versieren.spuitzakLeeg: The piping bag ran out mid-squeeze. It refills itself as she says this.
_line_ids.nina.versieren.opnieuw: The restart button — everything comes off the cake, and the cake stays.
_line_ids.nina.versieren.stil: Idle, alternating with zullenWeGaan. 'I am still here.'
_line_ids.nina.versieren.zullenWeGaan: Idle. NOT an instruction — see _why above.
_line_ids.nina.versieren.deurRonde: The door, mid-round, from before the party existed — the party is coming *straks*. SUPERSEDED by naarFeest on 2026-08-17 and kept: it is what this room would have to say again if the party were ever taken out, and ROOMS.md §4's contract is satisfied by VersierLine still naming it.
_line_ids.nina.versieren.deurBezoek: The door, on a visit. Still the only thing a visit can end on, because a visit's door goes back to a bakery that does not exist.
_line_ids.nina.versieren.naarFeest: The door, mid-round, now that Het Feest is built. The mirror of nina.keuken.naarVersieren: it can promise the party because she is about to be taken to it.
